items.title: Swiss voters reject 10 million population cap
items.description: Nearly 55% of participants voted against the proposal to cap population by cutting migration, results show.

items.title: Teen shot and buses torched in Manhattan after historic NBA win for Knicks
items.description: At least 63 people were arrested in the disorder after the Knicks beat the Spurs to clinch the title.

items.title: Protesters clash with police ahead of G7 summit in Geneva
items.description: Swiss police deployed a water cannon and fired tear gas to disperse anti-G7 protesters after clashes.

items.title: Tourist train overturns and injures 17 during Cártama tapas festival
items.description: Nobody was seriously hurt as a result of the accident in the Spanish town, local authorities say.

items.title: UK and Japan agree £18bn investment deal
items.description: Japanese firms will spend billions on UK infrastructure and offshore wind, Downing Street says.

items.title: 'Boyfriend duties call,' Trudeau says after skipping Canada match to watch Perry
items.description: Cameras caught Perry running off stage to greet the former Canadian leader with a kiss.

items.title: Fifa to pay Somali referee Artan full World Cup fee
items.description: Somali referee Omar Artan, who was denied entry to the United States to officiate at the World Cup, will still receive his tournament fee from Fifa in full.

items.title: Norway braces for verdict in rape trial of crown princess's son Høiby
items.description: Marius Borg Høiby will appear via video link, almost three months after his trial came to an end on 40 charges, including four counts of rape.

items.title: Author Chimamanda Adichie accuses hospital of stalling review into son's death
items.description: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie's 21-month old son died in a Lagos hospital, which she says is trying to stop an inquest into the circumstances of his death.

items.title: Armed men kidnap high-ranking security official in Haiti
items.description: James Boyard's abduction is the highest-ranking abduction in the violence-wracked country in recent years, according to reports.

items.title: Russian families use AI to 'resurrect' loved ones killed in Ukraine
items.description: The highly controversial trend lies at the intersection of Russia's war on Ukraine, new AI technologies and grief.

items.title: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in air strike, Trump says
items.description: Niño Guerrero was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike," the US President wrote in a social media post.
